articles.title: Mastercard Extends AI Agent And Crypto Payment Rails For Future Commerce
articles.mainIdea: Mastercard Extends AI Agent And Crypto Payment Rails For Future Commerce
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Mastercard Extends AI Agent And Crypto Payment Rails For Future Commerce. Mastercard (NYSE:MA) is rolling out Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent to support trusted, network-backed payments for autonomous AI agents on leading open agent platforms. The company is extending these AI agent capabilities through integrations with Lobster.cash and OpenClaw to manage authorization and oversight of agent initiated transactions.
